text: 1. Physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and without any physical or mental disorders that affect normal learning). 2. By September 1, 2025, the age of applicants for the doctoral program shall not exceed 35 years old. 3. Educational Requirements: As of September 1, 2025, applicants for the doctoral program must have obtained a master's degree. 4. Learning ability: Applicants should possess good learning ability and academic performance. The required score for the previous stage of application for applicants is 75%, and for those applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship, it is 80%. Applicants can provide other proof of their learning ability or academic performance, such as GRE or GMAT scores. 5. Language Requirements The applicant should possess the required language proficiency in both Chinese and English as per the admission criteria.
